verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an llms.txt file or docs published in a form meant for agents to read. The CLI and MCP evidence (agents can read and update Foreloop, `--json` has a stable shape, exit codes are meaningful) covers a different capability: agents operating the product, not agents consuming its documentation. That evidence does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
